title: Uruguay Names Squad for Match Against India
summary: Uruguay has announced a preliminary 46-man squad for an upcoming match against India. Coach Diego Forlan has selected the team, with no indication of a return for player Luis Suarez. The specific details of the match, including the date and venue, were not provided in the coverage.
summary_points: Uruguay announced a preliminary 46-man squad for a match against India.
Coach Diego Forlan named the squad.
Luis Suarez will not be returning to the team.
Further match details were not specified in the coverage.
title_hi: उरुग्वे ने भारत के खिलाफ मैच के लिए टीम की घोषणा की
